attributes.text: Hear the reminder: breakfast time! Tap me
Eat before or with morning tablets that need food.
Kamla, it's eight in the morning. Time for breakfast. Eat before or with morning tablets that need food. Eat slowly. When you finish, press the big button.
Say “I took it”, “I have eaten”, “one glass of water”, or “I'm not well” to call your people.
Today's plate: vegetables first, little salt, a small roti. Fruit if you want something sweet.
Look! A pink blossom opened in my crown.
It grew from our 1 day together. More will open as we go on.
